Priya (CS): Folks — Orchard preview hit 24 signups, our standard enablement capacity is 20. Need triage plan so we don't auto-waitlist high-priority customers. Sign-up: https://tiny.redwood/orchard-signup
Omar (AE): Who are the urgent ones? I'm worried about a couple on expansion paths.
Priya (CS): Flagged: EmberCorp (expansion/renew in 2mo), Meridian (legal review ongoing), Vaultix (SAML + custom connectors). I added tags on the sheet.
Dev (Engineer): If we split a session into two halves (core walkthrough + integration deep-dive), we can fit more customers without adding new slots. That would need an SE for the integration halves.
Maya (PM): Good idea. Also we should attach cohort metadata to the post-session micro-survey: cohort=orchard_apr, enablement_format=split/live/recorded, and a single NPS-style Q plus two product fit checks. Template: https://tiny.redwood/survey-micro
Nate (SE): I can cover 1 integration half-session on Wed 2pm. Which accounts need SE time?
Priya (CS): Vaultix and Meridian. EmberCorp only needs the core walkthrough for now.
Omar (AE): I'll reach out to EmberCorp to confirm preference for live vs recorded. If they pick recorded we free up a live seat.
SurveyBot: Note — cohort_size >20 triggers waitlist automation. Current cohort=24. Suggested action: tag high_priority to avoid waitlist.
Priya (CS): Action items: [Omar] confirm EmberCorp preference (ASAP), [Nate] take Wed 2pm integration slot (assigned), [Dev] split session template + calendar blocks (in progress), [Maya] update survey payload to include cohort + enablement_format (pending).
Maya (PM): I'll add cohort property and a boolean "followup_needed" derived from score<3. If followup_needed=true send CS ops a Slack webhook.
Dev (Engineer): Calendar templates created and split sessions added. Links updated in signup sheet.
Omar (AE): EmberCorp prefers live but later in the week. Ireesched to Fri 3pm; freed Tue slot.
Priya (CS): Great — moved EmberCorp, set Vaultix for integration deep-dive, Meridian gets recorded + office-hour invite. Marking Meridian as "legal-risk" in CRM so renewals ops can monitor.
Nate (SE): I'll prep an integration checklist for Vaultix and add to the invite.
Priya (CS): Summarizing: no auto-waitlist if we tag high_priority customers and use split sessions. I'll post a short recap in the morning. Thanks all :sparkles:
